Question 5 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 A man invested x rupees for 11 years at a rate of 12.2% simple interest. If the amount he received after 11 years was 1826760 rupees, find the amount he invested. Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 67 Correct% 54 Your time 5 Avg time 190 The amount he received after 11 years = the amount he invested + the interest he received = x + x * 11 * 12.2 / 100 = x + 1.342x = 2.342x The amount he received = 1826760 rupees = 2.342x X = 1826760 / 2.342 = 7,80,000 rupees.
